title: The five daily prayers and their times
intro: Each of the five prayers has its own time of the day.

learn.html: Allah gave every prayer its own time. We pray each prayer in its time – not too early and not too late.

items.label: Fajr – from dawn until just before sunrise
Dhuhr – when the sun has passed the middle of the sky
Asr – in the afternoon, when the sun leans to the west
Isha – when it is fully dark

learn.title: 🌞 Three times we do not pray
learn.html: While the sun is rising, while it stands in the middle of the sky, and while it is setting.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha – say them in order five times!
